strings: m_c curses {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} days of showing off {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} bendy paws in kithood, as now {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} joints ache, and r_c has told {PRONOUN/m_c/object} that {PRONOUN/m_c/subject}{VERB/m_c/'s/'re} hypermobile. Meaning that there is no changing it.

After moons of seeing m_c bounce around painlessly, the medicine cat calls {PRONOUN/m_c/object} into the medicine den to explain that the reason {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} joints have been hurting {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} is that maybe {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} flexible joints weren't the painless kind.
m_c's Clanmates look on when {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} joints bend in a way that most cats could only dream of.
m_c has recently been informed that most cats paws don't bend that way!
